label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: In sensible things there is an order of efficient…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., secunda via: Invenimus enim in istis sensibilibus esse ordinem causarum efficientium
interpretation: An observation premise, like the prima via's 'sensu constat'. Only its weakest content is formalized: something efficiently causes something. That the order found is a per se order is not read into 'ordinem'; it is the separate per se premise.
